description: This dataset lists the buildings in England that have legal protection for special architectural or historic interest, from the National Heritage List for England maintained by Historic England, as published on the government's planning data platform. The platform describes it as a beta geography dataset with 382,270 entities, attributed to Historic England, with each entry giving the list entry reference, name, listing grade (I, II* or II), start date and a point location, and linking to the list entry on Historic England's site. Many local authorities publish their own copies: the London Borough of Barnet provides polygons as CSV, GeoPackage and XML, and Harlow, Teignbridge, Norwich and others list layers on data.gov.uk, some without files. Coverage is all of England. Access: dataset page and a JSON entity API on planning.data.gov.uk. Licence: Open Government Licence version 3, with Historic England and Ordnance Survey attribution; free. Caveats: points do not define the extent of the listing; Historic England's own download page was behind a Cloudflare check today. Simulation uses: heritage constraints in retrofit, flood and heat adaptation planning. Related records: England conservation areas and Historic Environment Scotland designations.
name: Listed buildings in England (National Heritage List entries on planning.data.gov.uk)
